---
name: review-launch-copy
description: Review observed marketing language, tone and claims for a specific visitor goal.
---

Read launch/rules.json for CTA, vocabulary and recovery parameters. Quote the exact excerpt and scope the review to its language. Compare it with the owner’s offer and voice brief. NN/g tone dimensions are prompts for a human judgment. Suggest one replacement and keep the original meaning. If evidence for a stronger claim is missing, ask what proof the owner can supply. Never infer conversion lift from wording.
